description:
Cast Buried Alive to put Corpse Knight, Dauntless Bodyguard, and Haakon from your library into your graveyard.
Cast Haakon from your graveyard.
Cast Dauntless Bodyguard and Corpse Knight from your graveyard each for {0}.
Sacrifice Dauntless Bodyguard.
Cast Dauntless Bodyguard from your graveyard.
It enters, triggering Corpse Knight.
Repeat steps 4-6.
